hypothesis: Fixed source support and a continuous target inverse-depth objective may reduce nearest-pixel reassociation changes; domain-preserving line search may instead stall
data_role: already viewed development; local alternative objective only
initial_state: Same accepted starting poses and original incoming prior as the preceding ten-correction alternating control
initial_support: Start with original reciprocal source pixel IDs, qualify four target corners, geometry and gradient/source-normal alignment, admit at least 200 samples per factor
residual: F(q)=bilinear inverse target axial depth at projected q minus 1/q_z; divide by norm of dF/dq evaluated once at the initial poses
normalizer: Frozen independently per source measurement for the complete attempt; engineering metre weighting without a calibrated noise interpretation
moving_sampling: Interpolation cells may change, values are continuous across valid grid boundaries, declared right-cell derivative at exact pixel knots
domain: Every initially retained source sample must remain qualified at every evaluated pose; do not drop sources, factors or invalid costs to improve the objective
prior_and_ownership: Same nonlinear prior chart and unique raw factor ownership; no posterior accumulation, elimination or tracker commits
guards: Same scaled SPD condition<=1e6 and full per-node translation<=0.1m/rotation<=0.15rad; no damping or rank filling
search: At most eight Armijo candidates 1..1/128; invalid-domain candidates record no cost and are rejected; no valid passing candidate means line-search guard failure
convergence: Full continuous-objective proposal below strict 1e-5m/1e-5rad per nonorigin node; separately reconstruct original discrete fresh convergence, without equating the two objectives
comparison: Original alternating ten-correction control from exactly the same starting poses/prior; costs and continuous RMS across different objectives are not directly comparable
independent_validation: Relative-camera reciprocal selector and polynomial interpolation with SVD normals; independent incidence matrices, prior charts, spectral solve, Rodrigues search; twelve objective-gradient axes including nonzero prior
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must converge all five continuous objectives, improve original discrete fresh-converged count, have no local or fresh guards, pass original 0.03m RMS gates and have original discrete median RMS no worse than control
scope: No continuous trajectory evaluation or default-estimator change in this diagnostic
